name: The Echo of Crows at the End of Man
source:
After a worldwide pandemic wipes out much of the human population, two men find themselves the only survivors for miles. Follow through moments in the lives of Juste Marie and Clement Król as they learn to live in a world without any more people together.

[From [url=https://sweatdecadence.itch.io/echoofcrows]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场全球性的大流行消灭了大部分人口，两名男子发现自己是方圆数英里内唯一的幸存者。跟随Juste Marie和Clement Król学习如何生活在一个没有更多人在一起的世界中的生活瞬间。

[来自[url=https://sweatdecadence.itch.io/echoofcrows]itch.io[/url]]
